title: torilis arvensis var. purpurea
intro: Torilis arvensis var. purpurea, commonly known as Purple Hedge Parsley, is a biennial plant in the Apiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, such as bloating and flatulence, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Purple Hedge Parsley include its ability to relax smooth muscle and reduce spasms, making it useful in treating conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
